# AIDigiTools (aidigitools.tech) — Full Machine Knowledge Base

> Premier AI Software Marketplace & Intelligence Hub for Pakistan and Worldwide.
> Dual PKR & USD Pricing, Domestic Payment Rails (EasyPaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay, Raast) & International Rails (Wise, Binance Pay / Crypto USDT), with Instant 15-Minute WhatsApp Delivery and 30-Day Replacement Warranty.

## 1. Executive Summary & Market Positioning
AIDigiTools is an independent AI software marketplace and intelligence hub established in Islamabad, Pakistan, serving domestic users and international clients across the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Europe, Canada, and globally. AIDigiTools eliminates foreign exchange surcharges, credit card decline friction, and international transaction barriers by offering dual currency rails (Pakistani Rupee PKR and United States Dollar USD) with instant electronic fulfillment.

## 4. Payment Methods & Cross-Border Delivery
- **Domestic Pakistan Rails**: EasyPaisa P2P, JazzCash Merchant, SadaPay Personal, NayaPay Wallet, State Bank of Pakistan Raast, and Online Bank IBFT.
- **International Rails**: Wise, Binance Pay / Crypto USDT, Payoneer, and International Bank Cards.
- **Delivery Protocol**: Zero delivery surcharge (0 PKR / 0 USD). Electronic delivery via WhatsApp (+92 332 6861112) and Email (support@aidigitools.tech) within 15 minutes.
- **Warranty & Refund**: 30-day replacement warranty on all seats; pro-rata refund if unresolved within 24 hours.
